newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hong Leong Group in S$70 mln theatre complex plan.
newsitem.headline: Hong Leong Group in S$70 mln theatre complex plan.

text.p: Hong Leong Group Ltd said on Tuesday it was in talks with German entertainment group Stella AG to build a Singapore $70 million theatre complex in Singapore.
"We are in talks with Stella," a Hong Leong spokeswoman told Reuters.

"We estimate the theatre will cost about 80 million to 100 million Deutschemarks (S$62.4 million to S$70.2 million) based on Stella's experience of similar projects it has been involved with in Germany," she said.

The spokeswoman said the project was still in discussion stage and a suitable site had yet to be found, although it was hoped a location in a proposed entertainment zone in Bugis, central Singapore, would be identified.
The spokeswoman said the theatre would be the first of its kind in Singapore with seating for 1,500 to 1,800 people designed for world class shows like the long-running musical, Cats.
Hong Leong had no timeframe for the construction.
The spokeswoman said it was too early in the project to comment on financing proposals.
